strings.mdKbSmart: • Smat kibɔks fetch: de chɛk di kibɔks we de naw agens Google in rivokeshɔn list (CRL) ɛn tray fɔ yuz bɔku sɔs te i fɛn wan valid kibɔks, wit ɔtomɛtik bak-ap ɛn ristart fɔ Google savis dɛn. Rɔn pan ɛvri tap ɛn nid intanɛt (1-3 minit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Kibɔks frɔm nɛtwɔk: i de dawnlod wan kibɔks frɔm di ɔfishal ripɔsitɔri (GitHub) ɛn kip am na /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Nid intanɛt ɛn i de tek 1-3 minit. Dɛn kin yuz am we di smat fetch nɔ wok ɔ we dɛn chenj di kibɔks wit dɛn an.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: de chɛk di Rimot Ki Provishɔn mɔdyul dɛn we de, inspɛkt di TEE atɛsteshɔn sɛtifiket vɛshɔn, ɛn sho di KmInstallKeybox tul stet. Chenj natin — wan plain divays stetɔs we fɔ si.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine chɛk (rid-onli): sho Widevine lɛvɛl indikɛtɔ (L1/L3) frɔm dumpsys, DRM (IDM) ki-fayl prɛzɛns, ɛn rilat sistɛm prɔpati dɛn. Modify natin at ɔl.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fiks: de rɔn sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fiks atɛsteshɔn ishu dɛn we di ɔtomɛtik pas nɔ wok. Ɛvri rɔn de print wan klia sakrifays/fail layn.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ful RKP fiks: de rɔn sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ful. I de handle di had kes dɛn ɛn i de tek lɔng tɛm. Wan klia rizɔlt de apia na di ɛnd.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Riset GMS: de klia Play Store ɛn Google savis (GMS+GSF) data ɛn ribɔt di divays ɔtomɛtik wan. Fɔ stɛp atɛsteshɔn nɔmɔ — i nɔ de ɛva tɔch yu foto ɔ fayl dɛn.
strings.mdCertify: • Ple sɛtifiket: de chɛk di RKP sɛtifiket atɛst stet fɔ di divays ɛn riset di atɛst prɔpati dɛn if nid de. Nɔ de tɔch yuz data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER ripa: fiks Google savis fremwɔk (SOTER) ishu dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit divays atɛsteshɔn. Dɛn kin yuz am fɔ sɔm divays dɛn we de abop pan SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Aplay PIF: de rɔn sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh fɔs. Aplay di finga prɛnt we yu dɔn pik (lɔkal/advans) ɛn ɔpdet di pif.prop/pif.json fayl dɛn. Wan klia rizɔlt go apia na di lɔg.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF chɛk: de sho di injin stet we dɛn dɔn instɔl, di finga prɛnt fayl dɛn (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ɛn di lɔg dɛn. Chek nɔmɔ — i nɔ de modify natin.
strings.mdCanary: • Kanari ɔpdet: de rɔn sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fet di laytst Canary Engine rilis fɔ mek shɔ se i kɔmpitabl wit di mandatory RKP sɛtifiket dɛn (Februari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Injin dayagnosis: de chɛk di TrickyStoreOSS stet (pid, lɔg dɛn), di kibɔks fayl dɛn (aktiv vs yuza), di rial vs spɔf divays finga prɛnt, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP ki dɛn. Diagnostik displei nɔmɔ.
strings.hintKbSlots: Di modul de manej tu kibɔks slot dɛn: di praymari (sakri, nɔ ɛva wayp) ɛn di sɛkɔndari (bak-ap). Dis tab de sho us slot de aktiv, swich di prɛferɛns, ɔ promot di sɛkɔndari to praymari pan ɛksplisit riŋwe — wit bak-ap ɛn ful lɔg.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integriti diagnosis: de chɛk di TEE ki import, di laybri injɛkshɔn insay keystore2, di rivokeshɔn stetɔs (CRL), di protɛkshɔn-list kɔvarej ɛn di RKP stet. Rid-onli — i nɔ de chenj natin.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Sef ri-aplai:

• Dɛn bil di protɛkshɔn list bak frɔm ɛvri ap we dɛn dɔn instɔl.
• Dɛn dɔn ri-aplai di kɔstɔm-ROM kɔmpitibliti layt.
• Dɛn dɔn ri-aplay di aktif kibɔks.
• Google Play savis dɛn dɔn ristart.

Natin nɔ de dilit ɛn di praymari kibɔks nɔ ɛva tɔch.

Kɔntinyu?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Kibɔks slot: de sho di stet fɔ di praymari ɛn sɛkɔndari slot ɛn swich di prɛferɛns bitwin dɛn. Di praymari (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) de protɛkt ɔltɛm ɛn nɔ de ɛva was am. Fɔ promot di sɛkɔndari to praymari nid fɔ kɔnfɔm klia wan.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promot di sɛkɔndari slot to praymari:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml bi di praymari slot kɔntinyu.
• Di praymari we de naw de sev as bak-ap bifo dɛn riples am.
• Natin nɔ de dilit — di ɔpreshɔn de rivas.

Kɔntinyu?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Klia di sɛkɔndari slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml go pul.
• Di praymari slot nɔ tɔch.

Kɔntinyu?

strings.confirmGmsReset:

• Natin nɔ de wayp ɛn yu NƆ go sayn aut.

Kɔntinyu?

• Fɔ divays dɛn we nɔ de tek tɛm wit di kibɔks we lik.
• I de wok ivin if di ki dɛn wɛl.
• Nɔ data nɔ de dilit.

Kɔntinyu?

strings.confirmSoter:
